card.name: Partway through verbs like ingest, expel
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer verb split into parts, such as assim-, ing-, exp-, im-, prom-, div-. It sits right before the rest of verbs like assimilate, ingest, expel, mimic, promulgate or divert.

modes.label: Verb stems split mid-word
modes.description: The opening piece of a Latin-style verb, with the ending still to come.
